prior_exposure.close-v1: close-v1 read the whole 2015-16 PRO year up to each order's pull time, PRO-V dates included, and spent the close lineage's one test on PRO-V; on the lab it released, for resting GBP 2 BACK and LAY orders on the favourite at 10, 5 and 2 minutes before the off under three fill models: counts of records, codes, classes and fills, and fill rates; the machinery's counts: rises of traded volume by how they were counted, null values by reason, scored orders whose batch began with no status, scored BSPs that are whole hundredths, and whether the two BSP ends decide apart; quantiles of the size ahead of the order and of the seconds to a fill; pooled SDs and ranges of the score against BSP over filled orders and the SD over all scored orders; the detectable effect on PRO-V; means, SDs and intervals of the score against BSP, gross and net of commission, per cell and label, with the gap between filled and unfilled orders and the mid at the order time against BSP; the same by half-year for every cell on PRO-D and for the primaries on PRO-V; the selection, the tests and the labels; the filled means without first-second fills; and quantiles of the sum of 1 / BSP per market by label.
prior_exposure.early-price-v1: early-price-v1 read the 2023 and 2024 BASIC files up to 10 minutes before the off and spent the early-price lineage's one test on BASIC-V; on the lab it released mean last traded price against BSP for the ten level cells on both years, for all twelve move cells on 2023 and for two primaries only on 2024, with their tests and labels, and quantiles of the sum of 1 / BSP per market for each year; the other ten move cells of 2024 gave counts and pooled spreads only; its designer also knew movement-v1's late-move cells, earlier-window control and random-runner control on 2015-16, which its registration did not list.
prior_exposure.lp-v1: lp-v1 read the whole year and released join-leg mark-outs at 10 minutes before the off and fill counts.
prior_exposure.movement-v1: movement-v1 read the whole year and released taker NCLV by decision time with intervals and SDs; on the lab it also gave means by price band, field size and late-move cell, and raw tick quantiles.
prior_exposure.p0: The whole 2015-16 PRO year counts as inspected from P0's first run, which started two variants; their outcome metrics stay on the lab.
prior_exposure.p0-basic-2015-16: P0's run of 2026-10-17 read the 2015-16 BASIC files themselves: it decided two variants 5 minutes before the off on every eligible market of 2015-05 to 2016-04, each a back at BSP, and the index build read every such file whole, results included; its outcome metrics stay on the lab, and the last-traded-price-against-BSP metric its contract declares was never built.
prior_exposure.p0-basic-2023-25: P0's run of 2026-10-17 and the index build read every 2023-25 BASIC file mechanically, results included; no strategy, settlement or price figure of those years was evaluated or released, only counts and digests.
prior_exposure.suite-counts: Whole-year counts of in-play markets and of markets with a removed runner are known; they are counts, not locations.
